title: Quentin and the Current
author: S. M. Thackeray
blurb: Mirabel Underhill, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
